sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Adjusted several configuration setting defaults to more sensible out-of-the-box values: `sa_sidebar_collapsed` ("Start with sidebar collapsed") false→true; `sa_enable_dropdown_flag_icons` ("Show Flag Icons In Unique-Values Dropdown") false→true; `sa_uniq_dropdown_visible_rows` ("Unique-Values Dropdown Visible Rows") 8→30; `sa_auto_resize_columns` ("Auto-resize columns on load") false→true; `sa_enable_show_single_table_btn` ("Enable 'Show single-table' button") false→true, and dropped its now-stale "Off by default while this feature is new" description text; `sa_enable_ars_collapse` ("Enable collapsible 'ARs' column") true→false; `sa_enable_annotation_auto_expand` ("Auto-expand native 'Annotation' section") false→true. Only affects fresh installs / users who haven't explicitly overridden these settings — anyone with an existing explicit value keeps it.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: 📊 unique-values dropdown: fixed "Join phrases" entries (e.g. "&") disappearing after closing and reopening the dropdown on a column with an active join-phrase filter. `_findCellJoinPhrases()` required the separator text to be a bare DOM text node, but `_highlightJoinPhraseMatch()` wraps that same text node in a `<span class="mb-column-filter-highlight">` once the entry is checked — a re-scan on reopen (which runs without an intervening filter pass to clear the highlight first) then found nothing between the two credited artists. `_findCellJoinPhrases()` now also recognizes its own highlight-wrapper span in that position and reads its text content, so reopening the dropdown keeps showing join-phrase entries that still match the currently-filtered rows.
